desc: The PolyTac 1X is a compact, rugged tactical light built for extreme conditions. It features a durable polymer body with a stippled grip for secure handling and operates on an SL-B9 Li-Ion USB-rechargeable pack, CR123A lithium, or AA alkaline/lithium batteries. It also includes a TEN-TAP programmable tail switch and a two-way pocket clip for convenient carry.
